q: A ____ is a semiconductor device that converts light into electrical current. (2024)
e: A photodiode operates in reverse bias to convert optical energy into electrical current.

q: The basic operations in Boolean algebra are ____, OR, and NOT. (2024)
e: Boolean algebra utilizes three fundamental logical operations: AND, OR, and NOT.

q: An ____, one of the most widely used in optoelectronics, is a semiconductor light source that emits light when current flows through it. (2025)
e: Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs) emit light via electroluminescence when forward-biased.

q: An ____ gate is a digital logic gate that outputs a high (1) signal only when all its inputs are high (1). (2025)
e: An AND gate requires all input signals to be high to produce a high output.

q: The photodiode is a semiconductor device that converts ____ into electrical current. (2024)
e: Photodiodes are optoelectronic sensors that convert incident light energy into electrical current.

q: ____ is the process of recovering audio signal from modulated wave. (2024)
e: Demodulation extracts the original audio signal from a modulated carrier wave at the receiver.

q: The voltage drop across the zener diode always remains ____ irrespective of the applied voltage. (2024)
e: In reverse breakdown, a Zener diode maintains a constant voltage across its terminals.

q: A thermistor is a temperature sensor that exhibits a large change in ____ proportional to a change in temperature. (2025)
e: Thermistors undergo significant electrical resistance changes in response to temperature variations.

q: The process of changing some characteristics of a carrier wave in accordance with the intensity of the signal is known as ____. (2025)
e: Modulation alters parameters of a high-frequency carrier wave to transmit information.

q: A thermistor can convert changes in ____ into changes in electric current. (2025)
e: Changes in temperature alter thermistor resistance, producing corresponding changes in current.

q: There are two types of ____ breakdown regions in a zener diode. (2024)
e: Zener diodes operate in reverse breakdown, which includes Zener and avalanche breakdown.

q: A ____ is a temperature sensor that exhibits a large change in resistance proportional to a change in temperature. (2025)
e: A thermistor is a temperature-sensitive resistor used as a thermal sensor.

q: The resistance of LDR depends on the ____ falling on its surface. (2025)
e: The resistance of a Light Dependent Resistor varies based on the intensity of ambient light.

q: The wired connections between two points are known as ____. (2025)
e: Transmission lines are physical wire conductors used to transfer signal energy between points.

q: ____ diode allows current to flow in both directions. (2025)
e: Zener diodes conduct current forward normally and in reverse when breakdown voltage is reached.

q: Boolean algebra is branch of ____. (2025)
e: Boolean algebra is the branch of mathematics dealing with logic operations on binary variables.

q: A photodiode converts ____ energy into electrical energy when exposed to light. (2025)
e: Photodiodes absorb photon energy to generate electric current.

q: An LDR (Light Dependent Resistor) decreases its ____ as the intensity of light falling on it increases. (2025)
e: Increased illumination generates charge carriers in an LDR, reducing its resistance.

q: A ____ is a device for converting a non-electrical input into an electrical signal. (2025)
e: Transducers convert physical parameters into measurable electrical signals.

q: The basic unit of data in a digital system is referred to as a ____. (2025)
e: A bit represents a single binary digit, taking a value of either 0 or 1.

q: In communication systems, the technique of overlaying a message signal onto a carrier wave is known as ____. (2025)
e: Modulation superimposes information onto a carrier wave for effective transmission.

q: ____ work in reverse biased mode. (2025)
e: Zener diodes and photodiodes are specifically designed to function under reverse bias.

q: In transducer, the sensing element is called the ____. (2025)
e: The sensor is the part of a transducer that responds directly to a physical input.

q: ____ is a form of point-to-point communication. (2025)
e: Telephony provides a dedicated communication link between two specific parties.

q: The basic operations in Boolean algebra are ____, OR and NOT. (2025)
e: AND logic is one of the three foundational operations in Boolean algebra.

q: The process of changing some characteristics of a carrier wave in accordance with the intensity of the signal is known as ____. (2025)
e: Modulation modifies carrier properties based on the modulating signal intensity.

q: The commonly used invisible light for LED is ____ light. (2025)
e: Infrared light emitted by LEDs is invisible to human eyes and commonly used in remote controls.

q: The fire alarm will turn on when either smoke or ____ is detected. (2025)
e: Fire alarm systems trigger upon detecting heat or smoke particles.

q: A ____ is a light controlled variable resistor. (2025)
e: A Light Dependent Resistor changes its internal resistance according to light intensity.

q: The process of converting energy from one form to another is called ____. (2025)
e: Transduction is the transformation of energy from one domain to another.

q: The current is generated when photons are absorbed in the ____. (2025)
e: Photon absorption creates electron-hole pairs inside a photodiode, generating current.

q: The OR gate with inverted output is called a ____ gate. (2025)
e: A NOR gate combines an OR operation with a NOT inverter.

q: The ____ of the photocurrent depends on the intensity of incident light. (2025)
e: Higher light intensity increases photon count, raising photocurrent magnitude.

q: The AND gate with inverted output is called a ____ gate. (2025)
e: A NAND gate is a logic gate that produces an inverted AND output.

q: A modern light source that requires ____ voltages is the light emitting diode (LED). (2026)
e: LEDs operate efficiently at low DC voltages.

q: A thermistor can convert changes in ____ into changes in electric current. (2026)
e: Temperature shifts affect thermistor resistance, producing corresponding current variations.

q: A transducer contains ____ element and transduction element. (2026)
e: Transducers consist of a sensing element to detect signals and a transduction element to convert them.

q: The resistance of ____ decreases as the light level increases. (2026)
e: In an LDR, brighter light reduces resistance by generating free carriers.

q: The basic operations in boolean algebra are AND, OR, and ____. (2026)
e: NOT is the fundamental unary logic operation in Boolean algebra.

q: OLED stands for ____ Light-Emitting Diode. (2026)
e: OLED stands for Organic Light-Emitting Diode, using organic compounds to emit light.
